evals.prompt: my renpy main menu is just a boring text list, how can I make it look modern and not like renpy
assertions: Proposes a layout concept such as a hero background with a row of art tiles
Keeps Start, Load, Preferences and Quit reachable
Mentions a scrim or gradient for readable labels

evals.prompt: I want a Continue button on the main menu that shows a thumbnail of my last save
assertions: Uses renpy.newest_slot evaluated once and FileScreenshot with the slot
Handles the no-saves case with a disabled tile
Loads the newest save with FileLoad

evals.prompt: the fancy menu has hover effects but it's unusable on android
assertions: Explains touch devices have no hover and tiles must be normal buttons
Adds a small variant with larger touch targets

evals.prompt: how do I add a save slot name field in renpy
assertions: The main menu design skill is not the primary skill loaded
